correctness.rationale: The proof partitions all composites by \(\tau(n)\). The expansion \(V(n)/2\ge\sigma(n)+T(n)\) is exact exactly at \(\tau(n)=3\). For \(\tau(n)=3\) the auxiliary difference factors as \((p-2)(7p^2+6p+4)\); \(\tau(n)=4\) gives \(T(n)/\sigma(n)\ge n/4\ge3/2\); and \(\tau(n)\ge5\) gives \(n\ge12\) and \(T(n)/\sigma(n)\ge12^{3/2}/5>8/7\). Thus equality is unique at \(n=4\). Finite exact replay through \(100000\) is supporting evidence only.
